public.title: 01 Matrix
public.description: Return a same-sized matrix giving the Manhattan distance from each cell to the nearest zero in matrix. matrix is rectangular, has 1 to 30 rows and 1 to 30 columns, contains only 0 and 1, and has at least one zero. Moves connect orthogonally adjacent cells.
hints: Seed one BFS queue with every zero cell.
The first visit to a cell gives its shortest distance.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: Multi-source BFS spreads distance layers from every zero simultaneously. O(rows*columns) time and space.
